item.title: Meta AI introduces Llama 4 code models for open source developers
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta has released new code-specialized weights for Llama 4, competing directly with Anthropic and OpenAI in software engineering benchmarks.
item.content:encoded: Meta unveiled its open-source coding models today, designed to run locally on consumer workstations with state-of-the-art accuracy.

item.title: Mistral releases new multi-modal model Le Chat Vision
item.dc:creator: Kyle Wiggers
item.description: Paris-based AI startup Mistral has launched vision processing capabilities inside Le Chat enterprise workspace.
